[EN] The {@LinkCreature:10#10#baykun warthogs} are cutting our troops to ribbons. They're mean, nasty, and tough as nails, so kill them , but carefully—I want you to bring back some of the soft fur on their backs.

We'll trade it in Cutthroat Harbor for much-needed supplies.
[ES] Los {@LinkCreature:10#10#baykun warthogs} están destrozando a nuestras tropas. Son malos, crueles y duros de pelar, así que mátalos, pero con cuidado; quiero que traigas algo de la suave piel de sus lomos.

La cambiaremos en Cutthroat Harbor por suministros muy necesarios.

[EN] That'll do, . That'll do.
[ES] Eso servirá, . Eso servirá.

[EN] Just walk around our camp. You'll run into them in no time.
[ES] Solo camina por nuestro campamento. Te toparás con ellos en poco tiempo.
